job.job_description:
Key Responsibilities:

Design and develop Generative AI/LLM-based applications on GCP.
Work with Vertex AI, Gemini models, Model Garden, Vertex AI Studio, and related GCP AI services.
Develop RAG (Retrieval-Augmented Generation) solutions using enterprise data.
Build and optimize prompt engineering, embeddings, vector search, and LLM workflows.
Integrate LLMs with APIs, enterprise applications, databases, and data platforms.
Develop AI solutions using Python and frameworks such as LangChain/LangGraph.
Work with Vertex AI Vector Search or other vector databases.
Implement model evaluation, monitoring, security, governance, and responsible AI practices.
Deploy scalable AI applications using Cloud Run, GKE, Cloud Functions, or similar GCP services.
Work with BigQuery, Cloud Storage, Pub/Sub, Dataflow and other GCP data services.
Implement CI/CD and MLOps practices for GenAI applications.
Collaborate with data scientists, ML engineers, software developers, and business teams.
Troubleshoot performance, latency, scalability, and cost issues in GenAI workloads.

Mandatory Skills:

Strong hands-on experience with GCP.
Experience with Vertex AI and Gemini/LLM models.
Strong Python programming skills.
Hands-on experience in Generative AI, LLMs, RAG, Prompt Engineering.
Experience with embeddings and vector databases/vector search.
Experience with LangChain/LangGraph or similar GenAI frameworks.
Good understanding of REST APIs, microservices, and cloud architecture.
Experience with Docker and Kubernetes/GKE.
Knowledge of BigQuery and Cloud Storage.
Understanding of MLOps, CI/CD, model deployment and monitoring.

Good to Have:

Experience with Gemini APIs and Vertex AI Agent Builder/Agent Development Kit.
Knowledge of Terraform/IaC.
Experience with AI agents and multi-agent architectures.
Knowledge of Responsible AI, model safety, and AI governance.
GCP certification such as Professional Machine Learning Engineer or Professional Cloud Architect.
